## P4.17 — observed validation environment

APP_ENV=testing, DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory:. TestCase replaces Testbench/secondary connection configs with independent in-memory SQLite. These tests use no application database or media disk; serial execution, no parallel migrations.

PHP 8.4.1; PHPStan 2.2.15. The standard PHPStan launcher attempted to load its optional Turbo extension; PHP reported Dynamic loading not supported. The analysis completed with zero errors, but the warning is preserved in artifacts/P4.17-execution/phpstan.log. Final validation uses the installed restarter's phpstan.restarted=1 guard with --debug to run complete sequential PHP analysis without extension restart/parallel workers. No vendor/config edits or capability self-attestation.

The first standalone arch check exhausted the default 128 MB. The final invocation grants the same 1 GB used by the suite. The first suite also found a plan code in a source comment; repaired locally without a specification change. Original RED results remain in validation/*/final-001; they are not acceptance evidence. Type coverage uses the existing __PEST_PLUGIN_ENV=1 serial mode with --no-cache.

Route and scope were admitted by provider-thread-state (gpt-6.1-sol/high, frontier/high, exact cwd/invocation). The initial CLI call supplied --actual-route as JSON although that option expects a file; it failed before start. The corrected facade call consumed the adapter-captured JSON directly. Only one durable start exists.

A scratch Pest probe under the numeric plan directory could not generate a valid PHP namespace; executing the same probe at /tmp/P4BeforeProbeTest.php reproduced the real before-order RED. The formatted product regression now lives in DynamicFenceTest. The raw probe is archived as .php.txt so repository-wide Pint does not treat evidence text as source. final-003 Pint RED and pint-004 GREEN bind the same product; other seven checks are reused rather than rerun.

Historical predecessor source witnesses were missing from Git, producing REVIEW_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_UNARCHIVED for both P4.3 and P4.4. plan-work.py review-recover-sources generated exact source blobs/additive witnesses, committed separately at 7c8a183 as required by historical-consumption integrity. Original receipts/verdicts/specs were not changed. The witness explicitly retains original-lock-not-bound identity_limit; it does not invent old dependency-lock provenance.
